salary_details.corporate relations manager: Consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- on contract basis

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Administrative Officer Grade I: Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute or Two years Post-Graduate Diploma in Business Administration/Management from a reputed University/Institute with minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience (6 years for SC/ST) in one of the relevant admin areas: General Administration/Academic Administration/Admission/Executive Education/MDP out of which 5 years at pay Level 10 or above Corporate Relations Manager: Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute or Two Years Post-Graduate Diploma in Business Administration/Management from a reputed University/Institute with Knowledge of computer typing and Computer applications in office management with Minimum 5 years of work experience in industry or academic institutions in areas such as business development, career services, B2B sales/marketing, or corporate relations

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: For all posts, age relaxation and reservation norms for ST/SC/OBC/PwD/Ex-Serviceman will be applicable as per Government of India rules. No specific minimum or maximum age is mentioned for individual posts in the provided data.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Kashipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kashipur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Management Kashipur (IIM Kashipur), a prestigious government institution. This opportunity offers various roles for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIM Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Senior Administrative Officer Grade I and Corporate Relations Manager. These roles are crucial for the administrative and corporate functions of the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Senior Administrative Officer Grade I and Corporate Relations Manager positions. Candidates are encouraged to apply early.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official IIM Kashipur website within the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for IIM Kashipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for IIM Kashipur Recruitment 2026 is 14 September 2026. Applicants should ensure timely submission to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in any discipline or a Two years Post-Graduate Diploma in Business Administration/Management from a recognized University/Institute. Specific experience requirements also apply to each post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Senior Administrative Officer Grade I?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Administrative Officer Grade I is Pay Level-12, ranging from Rs. 78,800 to Rs. 2,09,200, or an equivalent consolidated pay on a contract basis. This is a competitive salary package.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. However, SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIM Kashipur posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for IIM Kashipur posts includes a Written Test, a Skill Test, and an Interview. Candidates must perform well in all stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains comprehensive details regarding eligibility, application procedures, and other crucial information.
